    '// Prisma Schema for Date Management App
// Supports SQLite (development) and MySQL/PlanetScale (production)
//
// For production deployment with PlanetScale:
// 1. Copy schema.planetscale.prisma to schema.prisma
// 2. Or use prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.planetscale.prisma

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "./generated/client"
}

// Development: SQLite
// For production, use production/schema.prisma
datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
}

// ============================================================================

model Product {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  barcode   String   @unique
  sku       String   @unique
  name      String
  costPrice Float    @map("cost_price")
  notes     String   @default("")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  inventoryItems InventoryItem[]

  @@index([sku])
  @@index([barcode])
  @@map("products")
}

model InventoryItem {
  id         Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  productId  Int      @map("product_id")
  expiryDate DateTime @map("expiry_date")
  locationId Int      @map("location_id")
  status     String   @default("Normal")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product                 Product                  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id])
  storeArea               StoreArea                @relation(fields: [locationId], references: [id])
  auditLogs               AuditLog[]
  itemTransactions        ItemTransaction[]
  expiredItemTransactions ExpiredItemTransaction[]

  @@index([productId])
  @@index([locationId])
  @@index([expiryDate])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("inventory_items")
}

model StoreArea {
  id            Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name          String
  subDepartment String?   @map("sub_department")
  lastChecked   DateTime? @map("last_checked")
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  inventoryItems InventoryItem[]

  // Unique constraint on name + sub_department combination
  @@unique([name, subDepartment])
  @@index([name])
  @@map("store_areas")
}

model User {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  pin       String
  role      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  auditLogs               AuditLog[]
  itemTransactions        ItemTransaction[]
  expiredItemTransactions ExpiredItemTransaction[]
  uploads                 Upload[]

  @@map("users")
}

model AuditLog {
  id                Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId            Int      @map("user_id")
  inventoryItemId   Int      @map("inventory_item_id")
  changeDescription String   @map("change_description")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relations
  user          User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  inventoryItem InventoryItem @relation(fields: [inventoryItemId], references: [id])

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([inventoryItemId])
  @@map("audit_log")
}

// Item Transactions (for in/out/adjustment tracking)
model ItemTransaction {
  id              Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  inventoryItemId Int      @map("inventory_item_id")
  userId          Int      @map("user_id")
  type            String // 'in', 'out', 'adjustment'
  quantityChange  Float    @map("quantity_change")
  notes           String?
  transactionDate DateTime @default(now()) @map("transaction_date")

  // Relations
  inventoryItem InventoryItem @relation(fields: [inventoryItemId], references: [id])
  user          User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([inventoryItemId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([type])
  @@index([transactionDate])
  @@map("item_transactions")
}

model ExpiredItemTransaction {
  id              Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  inventoryItemId Int      @map("inventory_item_id")
  userId          Int      @map("user_id")
  action          String // 'sold_through' or 'expired'
  unitsDiscarded  Int?     @map("units_discarded")
  financialLoss   Float?   @map("financial_loss")
  transactionDate DateTime @default(now()) @map("transaction_date")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  inventoryItem InventoryItem @relation(fields: [inventoryItemId], references: [id])
  user          User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])

  @@index([inventoryItemId])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([action])
  @@index([transactionDate])
  @@map("expired_item_transactions")
}

// ============================================================================
// File Upload Tracking (for storage quota calculation)
// ============================================================================

model Upload {
  id            Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId        Int      @map("user_id")
  fileKey       String   @unique @map("file_key")
  fileName      String   @map("file_name")
  fileSizeBytes Int      @map("file_size_bytes")
  contentType   String?  @map("content_type")
  status        String   @default("completed")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("uploads")
}

// ============================================================================
// Migration Tracking (for compatibility with existing migration system)
// ============================================================================

model Migration {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  name      String   @unique
  appliedAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("applied_at")

  @@map("migrations")
}
